name: Permute

x.description: Input tensor, any shape. Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

dims.description: list of ints, the desired ordering of dimensions (e.g. [0, 2, 1]).

y.description: Tensor with permuted dimensions, same dtype as x.

description:
Permute: Returns a view of the original tensor with its dimensions permuted.

torch.permute = permute(input, dims) -> Tensor

Args:
    input (Tensor): the input tensor.
    dims (tuple of int or list of int): the desired ordering of dimensions.

Example:
    >>> x = torch.randn(2, 3, 5)
    >>> x.size()
    torch.Size([2, 3, 5])
    >>> torch.permute(x, (2, 0, 1)).size()
    torch.Size([5, 2, 3])

Returns: Tensor with permuted dimensions, same dtype.
